s-1.ptxt: Remove Brake Master Cylinder Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the warning switch connector from the reservoir and disengage the clamp.
Using a union nut wrench (10mm), disconnect the 2 brake tubes from the brake master cylinder assembly.
Remove the 2 nuts and the brake master cylinder assembly.
Remove the O-ring from the brake master cylinder assembly.

item.ptxt: The master cylinder piston comes out easily, so do not hold the piston portion or pull it out. If the master cylinder piston comes out, the master cylinder function may be reduced; do not reuse it, and replace the assembly.
Do not do anything that could damage the master cylinder piston, such as applying impact to it or clamping it in a vise.
Do not remove the master cylinder while vacuum is applied to the brake booster.
Do not point the piston side of the master cylinder downward below horizontal.

Do not allow foreign matter to adhere to the master cylinder piston. If foreign matter adheres, remove it with a shop rag etc., and apply rubber grease to the entire circumference of the outer surface of the piston (sliding part).
Do not use any grease or oil other than that specified.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.3

s2.ptxt: Disengage the claws and remove the steering wheel cover lower No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the claws and remove the steering wheel cover lower No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Horn Button Assembly

s2.ptxt: Using a torx socket wrench (T30), loosen the 2 torx bolts until they turn freely.
Using needle-nose pliers, pull out the 2 torx bolts.
Pull the horn button assembly toward the rear of the vehicle.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver with its tip wrapped with protective tape, release the lock of the airbag connector.
Disconnect the airbag connector and horn connector, and remove the horn button assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Operate the tilt and telescopic mechanisms and fix the steering column assembly in its most extended and highest position.
Remove the nut and put matchmarks on the steering wheel assembly and steering column assembly.
Using SST, remove the steering wheel assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of grease to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt (09953-05020) before use.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Column Cover

atten3.ptxt: If the removal procedure is incorrect, the claws may be damaged.

s2.ptxt: Release the tilt lever.
Push the steering column cover (lower side) from the left and right to disengage the 4 claws.
Insert a finger through the tilt lever opening of the steering column cover (lower side) and disengage the claw.

atten4.ptxt: Open the claw to disengage it.

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the steering column cover (lower side).
Disengage the 2 claws and pins, and remove the steering column cover (upper side).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Instrument Panel Under Cover Sub-assembly NO.1
Remove Instrument Panel Airbag Assembly Lower NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts.
Detach the instrument lower airbag No.1 from the 6 claws and 2 guides.
Disconnect the connector and remove the instrument lower airbag No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Brake Pedal Return Spring

s2.ptxt: Remove the brake pedal return spring from the brake pedal support.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Brake Master Cylinder Push Rod Clevis

s2.ptxt: Remove the clip and push rod clevis pin, and disconnect the brake master cylinder push rod clevis from the brake pedal.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Brake Master Cylinder Push Rod Clevis

s2.ptxt: Loosen the lock nut, and remove the brake master cylinder push rod clevis and lock nut.

atten4.ptxt: Measuring the push rod protrusion from the brake master cylinder push rod clevis beforehand makes it easier to adjust the brake pedal height after installing the brake booster assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Check Valve to Connector Tube Hose

s2.ptxt: Slide the clip and disconnect the check valve to connector tube hose from the brake booster assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Brake Tube

s2.ptxt: Using a union nut wrench (10mm), disconnect the brake tube from the front brake flexible hose No.1 (RH side).
Using a union nut wrench (10mm), disconnect the 2 brake tubes from the brake actuator.
Disengage the 2 clamps and disconnect the brake tube from the body.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and remove the camshaft timing oil control valve assembly from the cylinder head.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Brake Booster Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 nuts and the brake booster assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not apply excessive force to the brake tubes on the engine room side.

s2.ptxt: Remove the brake booster gasket from the brake booster assembly.
